access_and_integrity.new_model_inference: Only synthetic test models; no learned predictor invoked by production diagnostic.
access_and_integrity.payload_allowlist: Runtime permits only the365registered development NPZs; raw RGB/HDF5/model.pt denied; static cache registration and per-episode split authorization retained.
access_and_integrity.review_gate: Missing/stale detached review rejected before dependency hashing or payload access.

assumptions_verified: Every selected bounded config has innovation_bound=1.
T is a row softmax and g a sigmoid; mixing and direct terms share channel coordinates.
No projection follows the complementary blend plus innovation.
Shared positive per-channel normalization is enforced by the frozen model and every selected config.
mathematical_review.closed_relaxed_envelope: For each channel c, all output patches lie in [min_l z0[l,c]-1,max_l z0[l,c]+1] in real arithmetic. Closing the tanh/sigmoid ranges enlarges the attainable set and therefore preserves the necessary-envelope property.
mathematical_review.identity_cross_check_repair: Only raw/normalized float64 consistency-check tolerance now scales as32*eps64*(1+abs(target_z)+max(abs(lo),abs(hi))+abs(mean/std)); primary envelope and FP32 sensitivity unchanged. Original fixed2e-12 cross-check failed a valid synthetic std=1e-5/nonzero-mean case before payload access.
mathematical_review.lower_bound: Squared distance to the coordinate box averaged over all6144coordinates is a relaxed standardized-MSE floor. Common mixture weights couple channels, so the box is not the exact attainable set.
mathematical_review.normalization: Initial subtract/divide follows frozen FP32 torch operations. Targets are expressed from original FP32 target/statistic values in float64; comparison is to the real-arithmetic raw-error/std^2 quantity, not a certified machine implementation bound.
mathematical_review.roundoff_sensitivity: Fixed32*eps32*(1+max(abs(z0))+abs(mean/std)) endpoint expansion remains separate and is explicitly not a rounding theorem.

population_review.comparison: All18selected bounded/no-tanh model receipts:3tasks x2modes x3seeds; existing matched per-trajectory error curves only.
population_review.persistence_check: Every window/all59offsets recomputed with unchanged frozen FP32 feature_errors; exact population identities and fixedrtol2e-6/atol2e-7 checked before completion.
population_review.primary: Equal windows within each trajectory, then equal eligible trajectories; analytical descriptors counted once rather than replicated per seed.

reporting_limits: Post-development exploratory mechanism diagnostic, not confirmatory evaluation.
No explained-gain ratio, no causal attribution and no new confidence interval.
A near-zero relaxed floor does not exclude channel coupling, optimization effects or other reasons for the no-tanh result.
Exact real-arithmetic violations and fixed sensitivity are separate; neither is advertised as a certified FP32 output theorem.
resolved_before_payload_access: Magnitude-scaled float64 identity cross-check; failing original draft retained in drafts/before_float64_identity_tolerance.
scope: Source, metadata/hash and synthetic-only readiness review. No dataset/cache/error-ledger NPZ payload opened and no diagnostic result or GPU/CPU execution job produced.
